title: The Barrow Doors quest text ('Promise, or don't -- you decide at the throne') doesn't make clear that the earlier reeve/priest conversations are non-binding flavor and the real mechanical choice only happens later at the throne; I only understood the two-stage structure in hindsight.
where: Last Light Square / Gray Chapel quest text
